📃 CONTENT:

# All phases complete — and the review against your original task

Three releases shipped today: v1.9.0 (engine integrity), v1.10.0 (as-of editing), v1.11.0 (chronology editor, income receipt dates, repairs). 425 tests green (from 397 at session start; every scenario in your spec is a named test), typecheck + lint clean, all deployed and curl-verified, ISA extended with 37 new verified criteria (ISC-154..190).

## Your spec, requirement by requirement

| # | Your words | Status | How it now works |
|---|-----------|--------|------------------|
| 1 | "Rollover should be against a category" | ✅ already true, verified | Carryover is computed per envelope and folds month to month. |
| 2 | "Rollover may include one or more budget periods" | ✅ | Carry accumulates across any number of months; per your answer 6, cadence handling stays as-is (calendar-month grid, cadence in charts). |
| 3 | "When I open up a category… see all current and previous budgets" | ✅ Phase 3 | The category page now has a **Budget history** timeline — completed, active, and scheduled versions with dates, amounts, and status chips, for expense and income alike. |
| 4 | "Budgets cannot overlap" | ✅ Phase 1 | Day-level non-overlap is enforced in the one write path every budget change routes through, and re-asserted after every version edit. Coexist-and-sum (the old checkbox) is retired. Prod verified: 0 overlapping windows. |
| 5 | "Adding a budget from 1 Aug should automatically update the previous budget's end date" | ✅ Phase 1 | The predecessor is always truncated to the day before — no checkbox, no option to get it wrong. |
| 6 | "I may also set it for the start of September — a future change" | ✅ Phases 1+2 | Scheduling works, and — the bug I reproduced at review time — scheduled budgets now **survive ordinary edits by construction**: an as-of edit is bounded to end the day before the next scheduled version. Raw API writes that would cover one get a 409 requiring explicit confirmation. |
| 7 | "Set an end date on the current budget, with no new budget to replace it" | ✅ | End-date-only edits apply at the engine (they used to silently no-op). End any version — past, current, scheduled — from the category page's version editor, or via the envelope modal. *Limit:* the master wizard's end-date field applies only to rows whose amount you also touched. |
| 8 | "Zero-based budgeting as of a date — today edits August; 1 Sep edits September" | ✅ Phase 2 | One "Editing as of" date on the master page drives the figures shown, the version each edit targets, the month-override scope, and the balance check (future months included). Both of your example sentences are verbatim passing tests. |
| 9 | "Editing dates should prompt me with suggested updates to the budgets either side" | ✅ Phase 3 | Window edits return suggestions: overlap fixes are **required** ("end the previous budget on 31 Jul"), gap-closers are **optional** — you apply both or decline the optional ones; declining keeps a legal gap. Your move-start-earlier example is a named test. |
| 10 | "Income effective date — before the 11th: rollover − spend; after: rollover + income − spend; no negatives before payday" | ✅ Phase 4 | Each income envelope takes an "Expected on day N" (income modal; "due 11th" chip on the grid). **Plan-based per your answer:** before the day, Left = carryover + received (no phantom deficit); from the day, the month is due — so *missing* expected income shows immediately. Expense envelopes untouched (your answer 1). Net Position compensates (with an "Awaiting expected income" line) so reconciliation stays exact. |

## What the engineering review found beyond the spec (all fixed)

The deep review that preceded the build surfaced defects your spec didn't know about, now all resolved: the dual-representation drift engine behind the $764.52 bug (replaced by one guarded write + one rederive); **1.43M garbage allocation rows** from unvalidated date inputs — 94% of your database — purged with exact conservation (474MB → 28MB, backups now seconds); silent this-month-override masking; moves corrupting scheduled budgets; parent envelopes double-counting on save; Pulse tiles reading a field the engine never writes (now wired to real figures); income created with its target silently dropped; and the chart cadence skew.

## Honest limits (also recorded in the ISA)

Ending an *unchanged* line item happens on the category page or envelope modal, not the master wizard. Grid rollover remains strictly calendar-month (your call). Income due-gating is whole-month granular against real today — multiple or partial receipts in a month aren't modelled. The category page's income editor can set but not clear the expected day (clear it from the budget page). Mid-month prorated scheduling lives in the per-envelope modal; the master wizard is deliberately month-uniform.
